translations.web: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
translations.bsb: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are disjointed. My heart is like wax; it melts away within me.
translations.kjv: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
translations.asv: I am poured out like water, And all my bones are out of joint: My heart is like wax; It is melted within me.
